summary: This showcase video demonstrates an Aura team composition facing Queen of Blasphemy (Area Boss 4) in Crisis Rally. The team features Talethia as the primary damage dealer alongside Anneliesis, Diantha, Lincos, and Child of Chaos. The team achieves 8.745 billion total damage in the 5-minute battle, with Talethia contributing over 95% of the overall damage. Gear builds and stats for all heroes are shown at the end of the video.
